conviction_note: One real finding: 910,904 in-the-money public warrants (strike $6.43, spot $6.87) must be exercised by 2026-09-30 17:00 ET now that the company ruled out extension or repricing, so exercise-and-sell supply of roughly 14 median days of volume runs through the 2026-09-23 session (-2.0). I cut that to -1.2 because the name's own 32 comparable falls have a +2.04% median next close with 59% up, because part of the overhang probably cleared on today's 3.66x volume, and because the $6.43 strike, 6.4% below spot, is roughly where exercising stops paying and the supply stops.
bar: The size of the supply is set against the company's own terms of 910,904 warrants at $6.43, exercisable until 2026-09-30 17:00 ET (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/22/3366263/0/en/nutriband-confirms-warrants-will-expire-september-30-without-extension-or-repricing.html), against baseline turnover (dv_med20 $436,740, about 62k shares a day at ~$7), and against this name's own comparable falls (n=32, median next close +2.04%, median absolute move 4.47%).

cause.label: equity_offering
cause.what_happened: At 08:00 ET on 2026-09-22 Nutriband confirmed that its 910,904 NTRBW warrants ($6.43 strike) expire 2026-09-30 with no extension and no repricing. That turned a known overhang into forced exercise-or-lose supply, into a stock up 66.5% in 20 sessions and 156% in 60, and it fell 11.6% intraday with no gap on 3.66x volume.

evidence.claim: Release at 08:00 ET: 910,904 warrants, strike $6.43, expire 2026-09-30 5PM ET, 'will not extend the expiration date and will not reprice the warrants'
Stock fell about 10.5% after the announcement, on about 6.9x average volume at the time the page was read (drop-day intraday)

A promotional piece four days earlier framed the warrant expiry and $7.65 close (Sept 17) as an 'economically meaningful incentive' to exercise, so the expiry itself was known and the no-extension confirmation was the new part
12,155,683 shares outstanding at 2026-09-04; no public warrants exercised in the six months to 2026-07-31

pipeline.next_dated_event: Warrant exercise deadline 2026-09-30 17:00 ET; each session from 2026-09-23 through 2026-09-30 carries exercise-and-sell flow
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A company 8-K or release on 2026-09-23 reporting that most of the 910,904 warrants were already exercised (overhang spent), or the stock trading at or below the $6.43 strike, where exercising no longer pays and the supply stops.

positioning_check: Nasdaq/FINRA short interest was 172,498 shares at the 2026-08-31 settlement, +1.4% vs 170,086 on 08-14, 3.76 days to cover on 45,923 ADV (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/NTRB/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). That is about 1.4% of the 12.16m shares outstanding (10-Q, 2026-09-04). It lags by about eight business days, so any short-against-warrant hedging put on this week cannot be seen yet. No insider trades in 3 or 12 months (Nasdaq insider-trades). The CEO's 13D/A of 2026-09-15 reports 14.2% (1,786,000 incl. options) and no present plan to sell. There is no options market, so there is no skew.

findings.finding: 910,904 public warrants at $6.43 that are in the money at a $6.87 spot must be exercised by 2026-09-30 17:00 ET now that the 2026-09-22 release ruled out extension or repricing, so exercise-and-sell (or short-then-exercise) supply lands in the 2026-09-23 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The deadline is fixed at 2026-09-30 and 2026-09-23 is the first of six remaining sessions. Holders who want the intrinsic value must sell or hedge before expiry, and the flow is roughly 910k shares against about 62k shares of median daily volume (dv_med20 $436,740 at ~$7), about 14.6 median days squeezed into 6 sessions. Even if all of today's roughly 270k shares ($1.94m) were warrant hedging, about 640k shares remain.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior warrant-expiry episode is in the baseline history. The 10-Q says no public warrants were exercised in the six months to 2026-07-31, so this overhang has never been worked through the tape before. The name's own 32 falls of 8% or more show a +2.04% median next close, and none of them is tied to a supply event.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the announcement, but it has not taken the flow. A share count sold over six sessions arrives day by day and is not discounted in one print, especially in a $0.4m-a-day name with a 3.1% round-trip spread where nobody can arbitrage it away. If the price already held all of it, it would be sitting near the $6.43 strike, where exercise stops paying. It is still 6.4% above that, so the arbitrage incentive to sell is still live tomorrow.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-18 promotional piece independently framed the ITM warrants as an exercise incentive (https://www.financialcontent.com/article/prlog-2026-9-18-warrant-activity-aversa-progress-and-a-potentially-transformative-fall-take-center-stage-nutriband-inc-n-a-s-d-a-q-ntrb), and the 10-Q gives the share base the dilution lands on (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1676047/000121390026097701/ea0303675-10q_nutriband.htm).

outside_window.finding: Warrant expiry at 2026-09-30 17:00 ET removes the overhang, and full exercise brings in $5.86m against $3.42m of cash at 2026-07-31. Supply ends and liquidity improves after the window.
3,008,643 Series A preferred convert 1:1 into common only after FDA approval, a large contingent overhang with no date.

The +66.5% 20-day and +156% 60-day run-up came alongside paid-promotion copy (prlog, InvestorWire, investorshangout). Unwinding a promoted run is real, but I found no dated mechanism for it inside the window.

searched_and_found_nothing: Repricing mechanism: the drop-day release is itself the primary document and says exactly what the headline says, so no wider reader finds a contradiction. There is no analyst coverage to publish a note, no Form 4 buys (Nasdaq insider-trades: 0 in 3m/12m), and the 13D/A of 2026-09-15 is the CEO's holdings, not a buyer.

ATM, going-concern and covenant text probes: 0 hits in the last 550 days (baseline forward block, efts.sec.gov). The 10-Q says going-concern doubt is alleviated and the $5m related-party facility is undrawn, maturing 2029.
Listing deficiency: spot $6.87, far above $1, and no deficiency 8-K in the submissions feed.

Nasdaq LaB Biotech Summit (the CEO attended 2026-09-16): already passed (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/09/09/3358786/0/en/nutriband-ceo-gareth-sheridan-to-attend-the-nasdaq-life-sciences-advisory-board-lab-biotech-summit.html).
Trademark opposition period (30 days from the 2026-09-08 USPTO publication) ends around 2026-10-08, outside the window.
Warrant exercises to date: neither the release nor any filing reports a count. I did not use the NTRBW live quote (CNBC) to avoid seeing a price after the screen instant.
No price dated after the 15:05 ET screen instant entered this reasoning. The stocktitan quote of $6.95 was drop-day intraday and was used only to confirm the cause.
baseline_tension: The finding cuts against this name's own reaction function (32 comparable falls, median +2.04% next close, 59% up) and against the cross-section prior for the -15..-10 band and <$1m turnover (+0.4%). It agrees with the high 14-day ATR (12.0%) and a moderate 3.66x volume spike. So the emitted -1.2 is 0.8 points smaller than the -2.0 finding.
